name: Standing Leg Curl
steps: Set the machine to your height and place one leg under the ankle pad.
Rest the front of that thigh on the knee pad and hold the handles.
Curl your heel toward your glute as far as is comfortable.
Pause and squeeze the back of your thigh.
Lower slowly. Finish the set, then switch legs.

common_mistakes.mistake: Lifting the thigh off the pad
common_mistakes.fix: Keep it pressed down and use less weight
Lower until the leg is nearly straight
